note: A10 mixed event domains (photon/muon/electron); analytic Cherenkov production with PhotonSim validation pending. Development only; not a reported result.
readout_note: readout_pmt_r6: the merged R-6 readout, dark counts on (1 kHz per PMT in [-200, 800] ns, ~2 dark hits/event). Dark PE bypass QE/CE, join the detected PE before digitisation and share the SPE charge, gain, discriminator and T-Q walk/width. Legacy labels readout_dark_off and readout_synthetic_unrepaired are kept as constants and are never written.

time_rule.source: author 2026-10-18, A9; imported from the PMT readout, not reimplemented
time_rule.store_time_ns: digit - trigger: trigger-relative token times after the prompt-window cut. The absolute digit times are exposed additively on the readout (HitReadout.absolute_time_ns), never in the store.
time_rule.leak_guard: the per-event emission-time offset (uniform in [-50, +50] ns, keyed RNG) is truth only: it shifts source photon arrivals, cancels in digit - trigger, is recorded in events.npz and never enters a feature or token
time_rule.note: the rule itself is not implemented here: lucid_bombs.pmt_time_rule() imports nhits_trigger_time, NHITS_N, NHITS_WINDOW_NS and PROMPT_WINDOW_NS lazily from noise_module_lucid.readout and raises RuntimeError until the author-named SHA is merged, so no dataset can be generated with another convention

fixed_response.module_index: dense mPMT module index: response_manifest.module_groups(mpmt_id) over the sparse WCTE ids (0..105 with id 45 absent), never a raw mpmt_id
fixed_response.twin_policy: present in the measured readout and in the nominal twin (detector response); the twin cancels only the injected F1/F3 gains
fixed_response.note: the charge gain multiplies the expected charge per PMT (measured and twin); the timing-width factor multiplies the digit Gaussian width tts_sigma_ns per PMT; the dark bank is present in the measured readout and shared with the nominal twin
fixed_response.dark_counts_stage_owner: readout (R-6): keyed Poisson dark photoelectrons per PMT, uniform in readout_window_ns, bypass QE/CE, then the same SPE charge, gain, discriminator, T-Q walk and width

detectability.v_dark_source: v_dark = lambda_dark*(1+sigma_spe^2) with lambda_dark = 1000 Hz x 1000 ns = 0.001 from configs/lucid_pmt/reference.json (R-6): 0.001 x 1.09 = 0.00109 PE^2, derived not literal
detectability.f3_source: F3 is marginalised with the in-force spread (0.10, the frozen section 3.5.3a ladder end): variance_p = mu_p(1+sigma_spe^2) + v_dark + s_p^2 mu_p^2; the tested F3 signal strength started at the registered default 0.05 and the ladder raised it to 0.10
